# Celestia: Stars & Dreams AI

> An Android AI astrology and dream interpretation app with personalized daily horoscopes, natal charts, live planetary transits, moon phases, zodiac compatibility and a dream journal.

## Canonical links
- Website: https://vcqapp-hub.github.io/celestia/
- Google Play: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.vcqapp.celestia
- Package ID: com.vcqapp.celestia
- Publisher: VCQ
- Category: Lifestyle / Astrology and Dreams

## Core capabilities
- Personalized AI daily astrology for general energy, love, career and health.
- Full birth-chart and natal-chart mapping.
- Live planetary transit and retrograde tracking.
- Moon phases and lunar-event insights.
- Zodiac compatibility.
- AI dream journal, interpretation and pattern analysis.
- Monthly energy forecasts.
